body.statement: On the restricted schedule class \(Y_i(2)=Y_i(3)\) for every \(i\), pool assignment labels \(2\) and \(3\). Under \(q^\star\), the resulting observation has balanced two-arm assignment, the target becomes \(n^{-1}\sum_i\{Y_i(1)-Y_i(2)\}\), and the exact orbit likelihood reduces to the shifted-binomial experiment of Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2026, Theorem 2.1). Its restricted-class second-order constant is \(-4^{1/3}a_1'\), providing the required two-arm sanity reduction without asserting that this restricted constant equals \(C_3\).
body.justification: The reduction verifies the normalization and distinguishes the new worst-case three-arm geometry from an embedded two-arm submodel.
body.gap: The published scalar experiment supplies the known special case but does not establish how the unrestricted eight-type adversary lowers the constant to \(C_3\).
body.consumer: The identity provides a regression test for symbolic and numerical implementations of the eight-type likelihood.
